title: appointments.slots.release_hold payload
description: Gives back a slot that was set aside (appointments#69): another time was chosen, the request was turned down, or whoever was deciding closed the panel. Idempotent — releasing twice changes nothing. It never touches a hold that was already CONSUMED (the request became an appointment): degrading that to `released` would lose the only signal that says whether the TTL is well chosen.

source.description: Who had asked for it — same value used to take the hold.

source_ref.description: The same opaque reference used to take the hold.
